canvas_categories.competitor_news: Competes with KPIT Technologies, Tata Elxsi, and L&T Technology Services; Tata Tech differentiates through its deep end-to-end full-vehicle engineering heritage, aerospace scaling, and anchor OEM partnerships with BMW and Tata Motors.
